verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs describe it as "an open source platform", and its core source is published in the public pulumi/pulumi GitHub repository, so the source is readable in the open. Missing for 10: the specific license (e.g. its name or terms) is not stated in the evidence; it is unclear which components, such as Pulumi Cloud or Neo, are open versus proprietary; and there is no independent corroboration of the licensing.
